load_vectors: load word vectors from a text file into numpy arrays with optional normalization and centering
save_vectors: save word vectors and their corresponding words to a text file in standard format
procrustes: compute the orthogonal Procrustes transformation matrix between two sets of vectors using SVD
load_lexicon: load a bilingual lexicon file and map source-target word pairs to vector indices
compute_nn_accuracy: compute nearest neighbor accuracy for cross-lingual word vector alignment using a lexicon
